# Freetierapis

> Free public APIs by category with auth, CORS, a docs-link check on every listing and real test calls with code snippets.

## Pages
- [Freetierapis](https://freetierapis.vercel.app/): Find a free API by what it does, whether it needs a key and whether it works from the browser. Every docs link checked; 114 no-key endpoints called by us, with latency and rate-limit headers.
- [Free AI APIs: Key, CORS and Link Checks](https://freetierapis.vercel.app/category/ai): Every free AI API in the public-apis list, filterable by key, CORS and whether its docs link still answers, with the ones we called ourselves.
